page_title: UDI 1-1 CAG | Udinese v Cagliari 18/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' Udinese have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+4' Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Maurizio Mariani saw the whole situation.
90+1' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Cagliari comes to nothing.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Cagliari.
83' It will be a substitution. Martin Payero (Udinese) is ready to enter the pitch as Sandi Lovric walks off.
82' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Maurizio Mariani has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
82' Cagliari failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
81' The corner is swung in but Cagliari can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
79' Gabriele Cioffi decides to make a substitution. Lorenzo Lucca will be replaced by Isaac Success (Udinese).
79' Substitution. Florian Thauvin did his best and is replaced by Brenner (Udinese).
78' That's the end of the game for Gabriele Zappa, who is replaced by Alessandro Di Pardo (Cagliari).
78' Substitution. Gianluca Lapadula walks off the pitch and Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) comes on as a substitute.
78' Claudio Ranieri prepares a substitution. Jakub Jankto is replaced by Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari).
77' Joao Ferreira (Udinese) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
77' Udinese take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
77' The resulting set piece from Udinese is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
74' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) places a shot at goal from the edge of the box that bends just wide of the right post.
73' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle for a foul.
71' 0:0 – the corner kicks stats.
67' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
66' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) makes a rough challenge and Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle for a foul.
65' Substitution. Jordan Zemura leaves the pitch and is replaced by Festy Ebosele (Udinese).
65' Gabriele Cioffi has decided to substitute Kingsley Ehizibue and he is replaced by Joao Ferreira (Udinese).
60' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) blasts the ball high over the crossbar.
58' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) threw away a promising scoring opportunity. He received a fine cross inside the 6-yard box, but missed to the left of the target.
56' Maurizio Mariani interrupts the game. One of the players from Udinese won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
55' Jakub Jankto (Cagliari) commits a rough foul. Maurizio Mariani stops the game and makes a call.
54' Lautaro Giannetti (Udinese) fouls his opponent and receives a yellow card from the referee, but he is clearly not happy with the decision.
53' Maurizio Mariani has a clear sight and sees a foul from Jordan Zemura (Udinese).
52' Nehuen Perez (Udinese) makes a strong challenge and Maurizio Mariani blows for a foul.
51' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Maurizio Mariani blows for a foul.
49' Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari) tries his luck with a shot from the edge of the box, but the ball crashes against the crossbar! It would have been a superb goal.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle as Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) was too aggressive in his challenge.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
44' 1 - 1 Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) heads the ball low inside the right post after a splendid cross. This timely header produces a wonderful moment.

43' Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari) slammed the ball from a mid-range free kick towards the net! He unleashed a low shot that went to the left, exactly where the keeper was standing. Such an easy save for him.
42' Maurizio Mariani blows for a foul after Walace (Udinese) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. It's a free kick to Cagliari in a dangerous position.
40' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) looks up on the edge of the box and rifles in a screamer of a shot that flies just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
39' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Maurizio Mariani didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
38' Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) commits a rough challenge and Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle for an infringement.
36' Jordan Zemura (Udinese) commits a rough challenge and Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle for a foul.
35' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
33' A yellow card for a tackle by Alberto Dossena (Cagliari). Maurizio Mariani doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
30' A precise cross aimed towards the penalty spot was met by Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese). He outjumped the defence and produced a decent header which went a whisker wide of the right post.
29' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
26' Jordan Zemura (Udinese) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
26' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
24' A spell of possession for Udinese in an attempt to control the game.
20' Maurizio Mariani shows a yellow card to Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
20' Jakub Jankto (Cagliari) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
17' A pass from Jakub Jankto (Cagliari) is intercepted by Maduka Okoye and the move breaks down.

14' 1 - 0 Goal! That was a fantastic finish by Jordan Zemura (Udinese) from just outside the box. He wasted little time in getting away a bullet of a shot that flew past the goalkeeper into the top right corner of the net.
11' Udinese concede a free kick following a bad challenge. Free kick. Cagliari will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
9' Rough tackle by Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
8' Jordan Zemura (Udinese) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
5' Jakub Jankto (Cagliari) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle for a foul.
4' The game is interrupted as Florian Thauvin (Udinese) is flagged offside.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Cagliari will have the kick-off.
Maurizio Mariani was nominated as the referee for this game.
